items_flat.title_en: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 5 — near-frontier intelligence at half the price of Fable 5
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 發布 Claude Opus 5 — 接近 Fable 5 前沿智能，價格僅一半
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced Claude Opus 5 on July 24, 2026. It is available today as the new default on Claude Max and the strongest model on Claude Pro. The model delivers performance close to Claude Fable 5 at roughly half the price, setting new state-of-the-art on Frontier-Bench v0.1 and GDPval-AA, with strong gains in coding, knowledge work, life sciences and visual outputs over Opus 4.8.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 於 2026 年 7 月 24 日宣布推出 Claude Opus 5。今日起成為 Claude Max 新預設模型，並為 Claude Pro 最強模型。該模型性能接近 Claude Fable 5、價格約為一半，在 Frontier-Bench v0.1 與 GDPval-AA 創下新高，編碼、知識工作、生命科學與視覺輸出較 Opus 4.8 明顯提升。
items_flat.analysis_en: The release strengthens Anthropic’s position in the high-value but cost-sensitive mid-to-high tier, potentially shifting economics for heavy agentic and enterprise workloads. Real-world differentiation will depend on sustained reliability versus Fable 5 and Mythos-class models under production constraints.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此發布強化 Anthropic 在高價值但成本敏感中高階市場的定位，可能改變重度 agent 與企業工作負載的經濟結構。實際差異仍取決於相較 Fable 5 與 Mythos 級模型在生產環境下的長期可靠性。
items_flat.quote: Claude Opus 5 is a thoughtful and proactive model that comes close to the frontier intelligence of Claude Fable 5 at half the price.
items_flat.quote_zh: Claude Opus 5 是一款深思熟慮且主動的模型，其智能接近 Claude Fable 5 的前沿水平，價格卻僅為一半。

items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA, Microsoft, Meta, Mistral and 20+ organizations release open letter defending open-weight AI models
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA、Microsoft、Meta、Mistral 等 20 多個組織發布公開信，捍衛開放權重 AI 模型
items_flat.summary_en: On July 24, 2026 a coalition of more than 25 organizations including NVIDIA, Microsoft, Meta, Mistral, Hugging Face, IBM, OpenAI, Y Combinator, Andreessen Horowitz, Dell, Palantir and others published the letter “Open Weights and American AI Leadership” on Microsoft’s site. It argues open-weight models expand access, competition and safety through transparency, and urges policymakers to avoid premature restrictions.
items_flat.summary_zh: 2026 年 7 月 24 日，包括 NVIDIA、Microsoft、Meta、Mistral、Hugging Face、IBM、OpenAI、Y Combinator、Andreessen Horowitz、Dell、Palantir 等超過 25 個組織在 Microsoft 網站發布「Open Weights and American AI Leadership」公開信。信中主張開放權重模型能擴大取用、促進競爭，並透過透明度提升安全，呼籲政策制定者避免過早限制。
items_flat.analysis_en: The letter marks a rare public alignment of major closed-model ecosystem players, open-source advocates and the leading GPU maker against broad restrictions on open weights. It reflects growing tension over distillation, Chinese open models and U.S. policy, though enforcement impact remains uncertain.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此信標誌閉源生態主要玩家、開源倡議者與頂尖 GPU 製造商罕見公開結盟，反對對開放權重的廣泛限制。它反映蒸餾、中國開源模型與美國政策間的緊張，但實際政策影響仍不確定。
items_flat.quote: Open weights—AI models that anyone can download, inspect, modify, and run on their own infrastructure—are an important part of that foundation because they make advanced AI more accessible, adaptable, and widely available.
items_flat.quote_zh: 開放權重——任何人都可以下載、檢視、修改並在自己的基礎設施上運行的 AI 模型——是該基礎的重要組成部分，因為它們使先進 AI 更易取得、可適應且廣泛可用。

items_flat.title_en: xAI launches free Grok add-on for Google Workspace
items_flat.title_zh: xAI 推出免費 Grok Google Workspace 外掛
items_flat.summary_en: On July 24, 2026 xAI released a free add-on that places Grok in a side panel inside Google Docs, Sheets and Slides. Users can analyze data and write formulas in Sheets, turn outlines into presentations with research and images in Slides, and draft or refine documents with Drive/email connectors in Docs. One install covers all three apps; also available for Microsoft 365.
items_flat.summary_zh: 2026 年 7 月 24 日，xAI 發布免費外掛，讓 Grok 以側邊欄形式整合至 Google Docs、Sheets 與 Slides。使用者可在 Sheets 分析數據並撰寫公式、在 Slides 將大綱轉為含研究與圖像的簡報、在 Docs 利用 Drive/郵件連接器起草或潤飾文件。一次安裝涵蓋三者，亦支援 Microsoft 365。
items_flat.analysis_en: The move embeds Grok directly into daily productivity workflows, competing for the same surface occupied by Gemini and Copilot. It is a practical distribution play rather than a capability leap, with success depending on depth of integration and user adoption inside Google’s ecosystem.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉將 Grok 直接嵌入日常生產力工作流程，與 Gemini 與 Copilot 爭奪同一介面。這是實用的分發策略而非能力躍升，成敗取決於整合深度與 Google 生態內的用戶採用。
items_flat.quote: Today we're bringing Grok into Google Workspace. One add-on puts Grok beside the file you have open in Sheets, Slides, and Docs.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們將 Grok 帶入 Google Workspace。一個外掛就能把 Grok 放在你開啟的 Sheets、Slides 與 Docs 檔案旁邊。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic Frontier Red Team publishes Project Pilot on AI models controlling real drones
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic Frontier Red Team 發布 Project Pilot：AI 模型控制真實無人機研究
items_flat.summary_en: On July 24, 2026 Anthropic’s Frontier Red Team (with Andon Labs) released research evaluating whether frontier models can autonomously control a quadcopter drone for locate-and-follow tasks. They introduced Drone-Bench covering reconstruction, localization, navigation, detection and following; Claude Fable 5 performed best but failed end-to-end due to reconstruction errors.
items_flat.summary_zh: 2026 年 7 月 24 日，Anthropic 的 Frontier Red Team（與 Andon Labs 合作）發布研究，評估前沿模型能否自主控制四旋翼無人機執行定位與跟隨任務。他們推出 Drone-Bench，涵蓋重建、定位、導航、偵測與跟隨；Claude Fable 5 表現最佳，但因重建錯誤未能端到端成功。
items_flat.analysis_en: The work documents concrete progress of language models into physical-world agency and surfaces dual-use governance questions around surveillance-capable autonomy before systems become reliable enough for widespread deployment. Bottlenecks in 3D reconstruction remain a clear limiter.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此研究具體記錄語言模型進入物理世界代理的進展，並在系統足夠可靠前浮現監控型自主的雙用治理問題。3D 重建瓶頸仍是明顯限制。
items_flat.quote: A key reason why Anthropic has a Frontier Red Team is to measure capabilities like this, giving us situational awareness into how close we are to the world in which AI can autonomously pilot robots—with all the attendant benefits and risks.
items_flat.quote_zh: Anthropic 設立 Frontier Red Team 的一個關鍵原因，就是衡量這類能力，讓我們對 AI 能自主駕駛機器人的世界有多接近——以及隨之而來的益處與風險——有情境意識。

Anthropic’s Frontier Red Team released Project Pilot evaluating models controlling real drones.
